definitions.explanation: A medication used to relieve pain. Covers both over-the-counter and prescription pain relievers.

examples.japanese: {鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: My headaches are so bad I can't go without painkillers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the painkillers prescribed by the doctor after meals.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{鎮痛|ちんつう}→鎮痛：14515_chintsuu⟧ (pain relief) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (medicine, agent). The suffix ～⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ is used for various types of medicines and chemical agents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to take a painkiller)
- {鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prescribe painkillers)
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい} (over-the-counter painkillers)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧ (pain reliever — more casual synonym)
- {解熱鎮痛剤|げねつちんつうざい} (fever and pain reducer)
